# Jaqyn

> Jaqyn is a loyalty and rewards platform for local businesses in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan. Customers collect stamps, points, cashback and vouchers from cafes, salons, barbershops and shops by scanning QR codes — no app download required. Businesses create loyalty programs, campaigns and group offers and track them from a web dashboard.

Languages: Russian (primary), Kyrgyz, English. Market: Kyrgyzstan, starting with Bishkek.

## Sites

- [Marketing site](%SITE_URL%/): what Jaqyn is, benefits for customers and businesses, FAQ, business sign-up form
- [Web app](%APP_URL%/): customer loyalty wallet, QR scanning, campaigns; business and staff dashboards

## How it works

- A customer scans a business's QR code (or shows their personal QR to staff) to collect stamps or points.
- Loyalty programs: stamp cards (visits → reward), points → cashback, vouchers with business-defined caps and expiry.
- Campaigns: individual, group (invite friends, check in together) and time-window offers.
- Everything runs in the browser; customers do not need to install an app.

## For businesses

- Local businesses in Kyrgyzstan can register via the form on %SITE_URL%/.
- Contact: hello@jaqyn.kg · Instagram @jaqyn.kg · Telegram @jaqyn_kg
